CustomField.description: 256 random bits from Crypto.generateAesKey, base64. The HMAC key behind every stored code and handle hash. Set only on the org default, only by scripts/apex/generate-key.apex. Never copy it anywhere, never put it in a ticket, and never change it by hand: a new key stops every code issued under the old one from working.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A secret. Do not copy, share or edit it. Changing it stops codes people already hold from working.
CustomField.label: Key
